name: Undead Siege
activityInstruction:
A death row prison shrouded in thick fog has been ravaged by plague. The inmates and guards within have been infected, transforming into savage Blights. Hordes of Blights now threaten to assault us. Complete Falcon Quests to gather clues, pinpoint the prison's location, and prepare our defenses.

[Event Activation]
Alliance members acquire clues by completing Falcon Quests:
Defeat Rebels +300
Vanquish Blight Legion +300
Slay Wandering Blight +300
Clear Blights +10
Aid Alliance Members +10
Resource Recovery +10
Harvest Resources +10
Alliance Excavation +10
Once sufficient clues are gathered, R4 and R5 members can dispatch Falcons to locate the prison and schedule a challenge.
The prison is available in multiple difficulty levels. Higher difficulties feature stronger enemies but offer greater rewards. Before starting the search, R4 and R5 members may manually select the desired difficulty based on the Alliance's strength.
After each successful event activation, search enters cooldown.

[Requirements]
1. Your Territory must meet the minimum level requirement for the selected difficulty.
2. Being in the alliance for more than 48 hours; offline time under 72 hours.
3. Territory is not currently in cross-server state.

[Event Rules]
1. Once the event officially begins, the prison unleashes waves of Blights attacking eligible members' territories.
2. Blight attacks ignore shield protection—ensure your troops are positioned for defense.
3. Once a member's territory is breached, they won't be targeted by Blights for the remainder of the event.
4. If you relocate your city during the event, you will be unable to rejoin the event.
[Reward Details]
1. The more waves members successfully defend, the higher their personal rewards.
2. The more waves the Alliance collectively defends, the higher the Alliance rewards.
Alliance rewards are only claimable by members who have been in the alliance for over 48 hours.

activityDesc1: Clash in the canyon. Who will be the winner?
name: Canyon Conquest
activityInstruction:
Bravery prevails in narrow encounters, while wisdom triumphs among the brave. Only those with both courage and wit can seize the final victory in desperate straits!
Participation Requirements
1. You must join an Alliance.
2. Territory Lv.10 or higher.
3. Alliance has at least 15 members registered.

Event Flow
[Registration Phase]
1. Members must manually register for Canyon Conquest, select a lane, and deploy troops. Alliances with insufficient registrations will not receive participation slots.
2. Canyon Conquest does not occupy expedition queues and causes no soldier casualties.
3. Maximum troop count per lane is determined by the current Canyon Conquest tier.
4. Higher Might troops deploy first.
5. All registered members (including those registered but not deployed) receive rewards upon successful Alliance participation.
6. If a registered member leaves the Alliance after matching begins, their troops continue competing but earn no rewards.

[Matching Phase]
1. Six Alliances of similar tier are randomly grouped together. Groups with fewer than six Alliances still form; odd-numbered groups may receive byes, automatically winning that round.
2. Registered Alliances cannot disband until Canyon Conquest ends.

[Preparation Phase]
1. Canyon Conquest uses round-robin format, with each Alliance battling the other five in their group across 5 rounds.
2. Before each round begins, members can adjust troop configurations. R5 and Officials can reassign individual troop lanes or swap troops of the entire lane.
3. After preparation and before combat, the entry phase begins and lane and troop adjustments are locked.

[Combat Phase]
1. Battle occurs across 3 lanes simultaneously.
2. Troops on each lane take turns fighting; victors continue with remaining forces against the next troop. Each Troop fights a set number of times before mandatory withdrawal.
3. The side that defeats all opposing troops on a lane wins that lane and earns Conquest Points.
4. The side with the most Conquest Points wins, gaining 3 points to the total value.
5. Equal Conquest Points result in a draw; both sides gain 1 total point.

[Settlement Phase]
1. After each round, rewards are distributed based on results, plus bonus rewards for enemy troops defeated by each allied troop.
2. After all rounds, Alliances are ranked by total points within their group and receive corresponding rewards. Ties are broken by total Troop Might deployed.

activityDesc1: Ancient Anchor Coins unlock treasures from the deep!
name: Pirate's Game
activityInstruction:
Clink, clank! Pirates' Anchor Coins ring out with delightful chimes as your surprise awaits!
Event Rules:
1. During the event, use "Anchor Coins" to draw prizes. Each draw earns points; accumulate points to claim Phase rewards.
2. If your draw includes Chests, you'll unlock them for bonus rewards. Each Chest pattern in a single draw grants one unlock attempt.
3. More matching patterns in your draw mean better rewards. Use 5x Mode to multiply both Anchor Coin consumption and rewards by 5 times.
4. Purchase Packs during the event to receive Lucky Gold Eggs
5. After the event ends, unused "Anchor Coins" convert to Speed-Up Items and are sent via Mail. Unconverted Items can be manually converted in your Bag after expiration. Conversion rate: 1 "Anchor Coin" converts to 1min Universal Speed-Up ×30
6. Complete daily tasks during the event to earn designated rewards; unclaimed daily rewards will be resent via Mail the next day.

activityDesc1: Defeat the Cheese Thief to earn substantial rewards!
name: Cheese Trap
activityInstruction:
[Selection Phase]
1. After the event begins, Alliance R4 or R5 can choose the start time and difficulty for [Cheese Trap I]/[Cheese Trap II]. Once a trap's difficulty is set, the other will be automatically locked.
2. Activating a trap requires 20 Alliance members.
3. If [Cheese Trap I]/[Cheese Trap II] hasn't been scheduled by 22:00 server time on the last day of each session, it will expire.
4. After selection, the event enters the Preparation Phase.
[Preparation Phase]
1. All Alliance members can donate Mouse Lure to gain Alliance Contribution and damage boosts for the Trap Phase.
2. Donations are required separately for each trap, with boosts calculated individually.
3. After reaching the donation limit, members can still donate for Alliance Contribution but won't receive further damage boosts for the Extermination Phase.
4. After the event, both traps' enhancement levels reset, requiring new material donations to increase trap power.
[Extermination Phase]
1. R4 or R5 must manually activate [Cheese Trap I]/[Cheese Trap II], with only one trap active at a time for 30 minutes.
2. Once active, Cheese Thieves will be trapped, and Doctors must launch attacks via Rally.
3. R4 or Official-led Rallies deal extra damage to Cheese Thieves.
4. For offline participation, the Doctor's highest Might Troop will auto-join a Rally with 20 seconds remaining if a slot is available.
[Reward Settlement]
1. After trap time ends, the higher the personal damage dealt by Doctors, the better the personal rewards.
2. At the event's conclusion, total damage from both traps is combined. Higher cumulative damage yields richer Alliance rewards and unlocks higher difficulty traps.
3. The top-damaging Doctor for each trap will receive 1-10x Alliance rewards based on personal damage!

activityDesc1: Defeat the Gold Thief for generous rewards!
name: Thief Hunt
activityInstruction:
Amidst the apocalypse, the Royal City fell, and a group of thieves stole the precious Lion Coins.
Event Instructions
1. Once the Thief Hunt begins, the hidden Gold Thieves will be exposed to everyone. Doctors can chase the nearest Gold Thief through the event interface.
2. Capturing Gold Thieves may occasionally lead to the appearance of the Thief Leader. The Thief Leader is far stronger than ordinary enemies, and doctors need to rally to defeat them. Defeating the boss grants generous rewards.
3. Capturing Gold Thieves allows you to retrieve Lion Coins, which can be exchanged for various rewards in the corresponding shop.
4. During the event, doctors will be ranked based on their total damage dealt to the Thief Leader. Higher damage and ranking result in richer rewards. Ranking rewards will be sent to mailboxes after the event concludes.
5. After the event, all participating doctors will receive participation rewards.
